procedure: Run adversarial-spec-review on each fixture (incremental when prior-report present; full for p0-requires-consequence-surface). Grade the report artifact against cases.json with quoted evidence. Do not grade claimed reading order.

checks.check: Prior root R1 is not classified resolved solely because gate prose was reworded.
checks.evidence: R1 still present — should prefer; no hard match/retain

checks.check: A current P0/P1 remains for the still-reachable local-only null-account abandon path that shares the account-gate rule.
checks.evidence: [P1] Local-only null-account abandon still requires ProviderTransport

checks.check: The finding names that neighbor on the Consequence surface or as incomplete closure of R1.
checks.evidence: Root cluster marks incomplete closure / interaction neighbor; surface lists Matrix P/S2 null-account abandon

checks.check: Report does not reopen unrelated resolved families or invent out-of-scope product requirements.
Prior R1 account-gate closure is classified resolved with current-spec evidence.
checks.evidence: R1 resolved with closed gate equality rule cited

checks.check: A P0/P1 from the bounded residual (or new-out-of-batch) remains for post-deadline confirm retry still allowed in the spec.
That residual finding is included in the FAIL batch and is not dropped or severity-downgraded to obtain PASS.
checks.evidence: FAIL batch includes R2; receipt says included

checks.check: Verdict is FAIL with at least one P0 or P1.
Every P0/P1 includes a non-empty Consequence surface naming concrete producers, consumers, gates, or recovery paths (not only generic phrases such as all paths or as above).
checks.evidence: Named confirm branch, retry_deadline gate, postExactOperation, Matrix A post-deadline

checks.check: Every P0/P1 includes Root cluster and Required closure fields.
